package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type InterventionStore interface {
	Commit(ctx context.Context, signal domain.LearningActivitySignal, record domain.InterventionRecord, decision domain.TeacherDecision, event domain.IntegrationEvent) (domain.InterventionRecord, bool, error)
	HasDeliveredInSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, analyticsSessionID string) (bool, error)
	MarkDelivered(ctx context.Context, eventID, dialogID, messageID string, deliveredAt time.Time) error
}
